What if I told you... your entire life might be FAKE?
Your family. Your memories. Even the ground beneath your feet.
What if EVERYTHING was just computer code?
Imagine discovering that Earth is actually running inside a giant simulation.
Gravity? Just another line of code.
And YOU? A character who thinks they're real.
But here's where things get terrifying...
What if the creators could pause time, erase your memories, or restart the entire universe...
If a simulation were absolutely perfect, how could anyone inside it prove they weren't living in reality?
Scientists have explored this philosophical possibility, but there's no verified evidence we're living in a simulation.
So tonight, look around you and ask yourself...
What if someone is watching you play?
